# Stellar TimeLock

> Non-custodial Android wallet and developer guide for time-locking XLM (Stellar Lumens) and other Stellar assets with Soroban smart contracts: time-lock vaults, cooling-off withdrawals and vesting schedules. The wallet is source available under GPL-3.0.

The developer guide has working @stellar/stellar-sdk 17.x (JavaScript) examples, each run against Stellar testnet. It also explains how Soroban time-lock contracts differ from Stellar transaction time bounds (minTime/maxTime) and claimable balance time predicates. No third-party audit is claimed. Nothing on this site is financial advice.

## Developer docs

- [Developer guide](https://stellartimelock.com/developers/): setup, payments with memos, Soroban time-lock vault, cooling-off and vesting vaults, time bounds vs. time locks, SEP-7 pay links, FAQ
- [Time-lock vault example (xlm_vault)](https://stellartimelock.com/developers/#timelock): create_vault, deposit, extend_lock, withdraw, get_vault, list_owned
- [Cooling-off and vesting example (multi_asset_vault_v2)](https://stellartimelock.com/developers/#cooling): create_cooling_off_vault, initiate_withdrawal, create_vesting_vault, get_unlocked_amount, withdraw_vested
- [Time bounds vs. time-lock vaults](https://stellartimelock.com/developers/#timebounds): setTimebounds, tx_too_early, claimable balance NOT(BEFORE_ABSOLUTE_TIME) predicates
- [Developer FAQ](https://stellartimelock.com/developers/#faq)
